name: Break-even ROAS calculator
blurb: The lowest ROAS where your ads stop losing money, with fees, shipping and returns counted. Gives you the target ROAS to enter in Google Ads.

name: UTM link builder
blurb: Tagged links that land in the right GA4 channel. Flags capitals, spaces and mediums GA4 won't recognise, fixes them in one click, and does a whole spreadsheet at once.

name: Search result preview
blurb: See exactly where Google cuts your title, meta description and search ad, by real pixel width, on desktop and mobile side by side.

name: Search ad checker
blurb: Catch the responsive search ad mistakes Google's editor lets through: limits, near-duplicates, pins that box you in, and banned punctuation. Shuffle through the real ads your pins allow.

name: Merchant Center feed checker
blurb: Drop in a product feed and every row Google would reject or limit turns red, with the reason in plain English, before you upload it. Nothing leaves your browser.

name: Amazon listing checker
blurb: Paste a listing and see what Amazon would reject or suppress before you publish: title, bullet and search term limits (in bytes), banned characters, repeated words and claims Amazon doesn't allow, highlighted in place.

name: Ad safe-zone checker
blurb: Drop in a vertical ad and see it on TikTok, Reels, Stories, Facebook Reels and Shorts at once, with the parts each app's buttons and captions cover. It checks those spots for text and logos for you.

name: GA4 event name checker
blurb: Paste your GA4 event list and see, before you ship the tracking, which events GA4 will reject, silently drop or split into separate reports. Fix every name to snake_case and Google's recommended events in one click.

name: Email subject line preview
blurb: See where Gmail, Apple Mail and Outlook cut your subject line and preheader, on phone and desktop, and exactly which words get hidden. Catches an offer after the cut, an empty or repeated preheader, and spammy caps, !!! and emoji.

name: A/B test calculator in plain English
blurb: Type in your test so far and get one sentence back: who is ahead, how sure you can be, and how many more days it needs at your traffic. Catches peeking, tests under a week, a broken 50/50 split and lifts too small to ever show.
